input.quote: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
input.rationale: This is an undefined-scope, worldwide, 24-month post-term non-compete binding Customer — our walk-away position. It also contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no non-compete commitment. We deleted it; if Vendor needs protection we could consider a term-only restriction on one named competing product with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.

input.quote: Before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
input.rationale: Conditioning our engagement of any other provider on disclosing and matching offers operates as a right of first refusal and de facto exclusive dealing for the full term, with no performance-based exit — our walk-away position, and inconsistent with Section 12.3's no-exclusivity acknowledgement (reinforced by the take-or-pay lock-in in Section 2.1). We deleted the clause.
